index_meta_title: Kurly – a friendly app for building curl commands
index_meta_description: Kurly is a free desktop app for macOS, Windows and Linux. Build curl commands with a form, import them from your browser, run them, and read nicely formatted responses. In English and Japanese.
hero_eyebrow: Free and open source · macOS · Windows · Linux
hero_lead: Kurly is a friendly desktop app for building curl commands. Fill in a form and copy the exact command, or run it and read a neatly formatted response.
screenshot_alt: The Kurly window. On the left, a form with the URL, method and headers of a request. On the right, the matching curl command and the request's JSON response, neatly indented.
features_title: Everything a request needs, nothing it doesn't
features_lead: Kurly turns curl's many options into a form you can read at a glance.
feature_build_text: URL, method, headers, body, login, timeouts and the most-used options. The command updates as you type.
feature_import_text: In your browser's developer tools, choose Copy as cURL on any request and paste it into Kurly. Both bash and Windows formats work.
feature_run_title: Run it and read the response
feature_run_text: Send the request with the curl already on your computer. JSON and XML responses come back neatly indented, keys in their original order.
feature_copy_text: Short or long option names, on one line or split across several, quoted safely for macOS and Linux shells.
feature_lang_text: Kurly starts in your system's language. Switch any time; it remembers your choice.
feature_private_text: No account, no tracking. Requests go straight from your computer, through your own curl.
steps_title: From your browser to a working command in seconds
step_1: In your browser's developer tools, open the Network tab, right-click a request and choose Copy → Copy as cURL.
step_2: In Kurly, click Import curl command… (Ctrl/⌘+Shift+I). It's already filled in from your clipboard.
step_3: Adjust anything in the form, then press Run (Ctrl/⌘+Return) to see the response.
terminal_caption: A command copied from the browser
download_lead: Free for macOS, Windows and Linux.
download_mac_note: Open the disk image and drag Kurly into Applications. If macOS says it can't check the app, allow it once in System Settings → Privacy & Security → Open Anyway.
download_win_note: Unzip and run Kurly.exe; there's nothing to install. If SmartScreen appears, choose More info → Run anyway.
download_linux_note: Make it executable with chmod +x Kurly-*.AppImage and run it. On Arch Linux you can also build a package.
download_curl_note: Kurly uses the curl command to run requests. It's already installed on macOS, Windows 10 and later, and nearly every Linux distribution.
